title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Electric Field — 2023
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: State Gauss's law. Use it to find the electric field due to an infinite plane sheet of charge.
questions.solution:
**Gauss's law:** Total electric flux through a closed surface = q_enclosed/ε₀.

For infinite plane with surface charge σ: Use a cylindrical Gaussian pillbox.
Flux = E×A (both sides) = σA/ε₀
→ **E = σ/(2ε₀)** — uniform field independent of distance from sheet.
questions.knowledgeNote: Electric field due to infinite plane sheet is uniform and perpendicular to the sheet.

questions.question: Find the electric field intensity at a point 2 m from a point charge of +4 microC. Take $k = 9 \times 10^9\ \text{N m}^2\text{C}^{-2}$.
questions.solution:
**Step 1 — Given:** $q = 4 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{C},\ r = 2\ \text{m}$

**Step 2 — Electric field intensity due to a point charge:**
$$E = \frac{kq}{r^2} = \frac{(9 \times 10^9)(4 \times 10^{-6})}{(2)^2}$$
$$E = \frac{36 \times 10^3}{4}$$
$$\boxed{E = \mathbf{9 \times 10^3\ \text{N/C}}$$

**Step 3 — Direction:** The charge is positive, so the field is directed **radially outward** from the charge.

**Step 4 — Alternative form using force on a test charge:**
$$\text{If } q_0 = 1\ \mu\text{C}, \quad F = kq q_0/r^2 = 9\times10^9 \times 4\times10^{-6}\times10^{-6}/4 = 9 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{N}$$
$$E = \frac{F}{q_0} = \frac{9 \times 10^{-3}}{10^{-6}} = 9 \times 10^3\ \text{N/C}$$ ✓
questions.knowledgeNote: Electric field intensity of a point charge equals kq divided by the square of the distance, in newtons per coulomb.
